name: skylane-air-quality
description: Playwright + k6 test suite for the SkyLane Air demo airline app, with Docker and CI

scripts.k6:smoke: docker compose --profile perf run --rm k6 run --summary-export /results/smoke-summary.json /scripts/scenarios/smoke.js
scripts.k6:load: docker compose --profile perf run --rm k6 run --summary-export /results/load-summary.json /scripts/scenarios/load.js
scripts.k6:stress: docker compose --profile perf run --rm k6 run --summary-export /results/stress-summary.json /scripts/scenarios/stress.js
scripts.k6:spike: docker compose --profile perf run --rm k6 run --summary-export /results/spike-summary.json /scripts/scenarios/spike.js
scripts.k6:oversell: docker compose --profile perf run --rm k6 run --summary-export /results/oversell-summary.json /scripts/scenarios/oversell.js
